hook: Dorothee Bär has been Germany's Federal Minister of Research, Technology and Space since 6 May 2025, according to the federal government. Her ministry, BMFTR, plans more than €1.6 billion for AI in the current legislative period.
name: Dorothee Bär
moniker: Germany's Federal Minister of Research, Technology and Space

timeline.event: Becomes Federal Minister of Research, Technology and Space, 6 May

quick_facts: Federal Minister of Research, Technology and Space (Bundesministerin für Forschung, Technologie und Raumfahrt) since 6 May 2025 (federal government)
Her ministry, BMFTR, plans more than €1.6 billion for AI in the current legislative period (BMFTR)
source_basis: Written from the federal government's cabinet page for Dorothee Bär and her ministry's AI page, read on 2026-10-24 (bridge row 1253). Facts are limited to what those pages state.

editor_points.desc: The federal government lists Dorothee Bär as Federal Minister of Research, Technology and Space since 6 May 2025.
editor_points.name: Minister
